text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
As expected, the atmosphere here is different.
There's a real tension in the air.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a lie to say I don't. But if I let that
scare me, it'd ruin the name of "Hishi Amazon".

"From that clear declaration,
her resolve came through loud and clear."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the moment has arrived.
The Senior Class GⅠ race, the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just which Umamusume
will emerge victorious from this fierce battle—!
